name: ollama-benchmark
description: A multi-task evaluation suite intended to benchmark instruction-following and general LLM capabilities (responses, reasoning, and code) as used in the Ollama community. It aggregates a variety of prompt types to compare open models on common generation and reasoning tasks.
general_score_metric: accuracy (with task-specific metrics for code and generation tasks)
reputation: Community-curated benchmark used for comparing Ollama-hosted models and similar open LLMs; modest community use for model-to-model comparisons.
